content: John Kwatjeh Irrpelh-ilenh-ilenhel tjerrtj map inenhkwatj-warn irrpelh-ilemel baptise-em-ilek
Pwek nhenh Mark-henh angketj mwerr Jesu Christ-akert anem, Altjerr-henh Ler-akert.
Altjerr-henh angketj angenh-angenh Isaiah rangemeh Altjerr-henh angketj pip-warn ngkwey arrernekarl,

content.text: Angketj thang awek, rrkwalel ntangkelhemel arlkerleh,
Angketj lakenh angketj angenh-angenh Isaiah-el pip-warn ngkwey arrernekarl.

content: Angketj nhenh arratj-irremel arlpaw-irrek. John Kwatjeh Irrpelh-ilenh-ilenh rang rrkwal-warn alhek. Rang mantarr kamwerl yenp-penh mpwarek-arleh irrpetjart, rang belt yenp-penhel ayernelhetjart. Rang inteltj ngkwarl rltwamp thwen war arlkwetjart. Itja mern ker arrpenh-arlk apek. Tjerrtj Judea ntjaper-areny map, tjerrtj town Jerusalem-areny map kwer-warn alhek. John-el inenh ilek, “Arrantherr anetjeng Altjerr-warn twep-irrerrang! Kwereng arrantherrenh thang kwatj-warn irrpelh-ilemel baptise-em-iletjenheng, Altjerrel anetj arrehantherr-henh wetjenheng.” Angketj nhenh awemel inang kangkwerrek. Inang anetj inehenh ilelhek, kwer-penh John rang inenh Jordan ulpayel kwatj-warn irrpelh-ilemel baptise-em-ilek.
John-elemeh tjerrtj map ilek, “Artwang arrpenh tjengeng ingkern petjem. Rang tjengeng twer anthwerr anem. Yeng anetj-anetj war anem, rang arratj anthwerr.
Thang arrantherrenh kwatj-warn irrpelh-ilemel baptise-em-ilem. Rang arrantherrenh Kwerrern Alngaltarel-ayeng irrpelh-ilemel baptise-em-iletjenh.”
John-el Jesu kwatj-warn irrpelh-ilemelbaptise-em-ilek
Arltang arrpenhel Jesu Nazareth town-eng John-warn alhek. Nazareth rartek mer Galilee-el anek. John-el Jesu renh Jordan ulpayel kwatj-warn irrpelh-ilemel baptise-em-ilek.
Jesu kwatjeng arratemel arek alker altjwer-irremeng. Rang arek Kwerrern Alngaltar kwerel-ayeng arrernelhetj-alhemeng, thep ntwerrert-arteh.
Kwer-penh rang Altjerr renh awek, alkereng angkemeng, “Ntwang Ler tjengenh anem. Yeng ngkweng nyerrkem. Yeng ngkweng-penh arrken anthwerr awelhem!”
Arrentjel Jesu renh arrkernek
Kwer-penh Kwerrern Alngaltarel Jesu renh rrkwal-warn lanthek.
Jesu rang arltang 40-eh-atwetj kweny 40-eh-atwetj rrkwalel anek. Arrentjelemeh renh arrkernek. Jesu ker nwanth-areny mapel-arleng mpwepel anek. Angel alker-areny mapel renh arntarnt-arek.
Jesu-el tjerrtj map kaltj-anthek
King Herod-elemeh John antwerrkekarleng-rlwer, Jesu mer Galilee-warn alhek. Rang tjerrtj map Altjerr-henh angketj mwerr ilek.

Rang inenh lakenh ilek, “Kel arltang rang anememeh! Arltang nhenh Altjerrel arrwekel kwet ngkernekarl, Altjerr tjerrtj mapeh mernelhetjeh, rang Ngkart angerr ineh anemeng. Kel Altjerr-warn twep-irrerrerrang! Angketj mwerr renh naketjeh!”
Jesu-el irrpenng antwerrkenh-rrkenh 4 ngwek,kwertengerl kwerenh anetjeh
Jesu Galilee kwatj alay iterel nthwerl-apek. Rang Simon tjey kwerenh Andrew renh-atherrenh arek, ratherr net kwatj-warn wemeng, irrpenng antwerrketjeh. Ratherr irrpenng antwerrkenh-rrkenh anek.
Jesu-el renh-atherrenh ngwek, “Tjengel-arleng petj-alherray, thang mpwelenh kaltj-anthetjeh, tjerrtj map mpwel twepelh-iletjeh Altjerr-warn.”
Akenheng ratherr kel net kwer-atherrenh mentj imperl-alherrek. Jesu-el-arleng ratherr anharrel-ayeng alherrek.

Jesu Simon Andrew inang kwek war ntwarr alhek. Inang akenheng-atherr James John thwen arek, Zebedee-kenh ler atherr. Ratherr boat-el anetjam, net kwer-atherrenh alterrelhekarl ratherr tantherl-anerretjam.
Jesu-el renh-atherrenh ilek, “Tjengel-arleng petj-alherrang.” Ratherr kel angey kwer-atherrenh-henh rrkwapenh-apenh map imperl-alherrek boat-arleh. Ratherr kel Jesu-el-arleng anharrel alherrek.
Artwang kwerrern anetj-akert
Inang Capernaum town-warn alhek. Kwereng Saturday arlta angerrel Jesu rang church-warn irrpek. Rang tjerrtj map kaltj-anthek.

Inang angketj kwerenheh anwerlkemel awek. Inang angkerrek, “Rartek angketj twerel kaltj-anthem, itja kaltj-anthenh-anthenh nheng mapel-arteh. Inartek kern war kaltj-anthem, angketj apekapel twer-kwenyel!”
Jesu-el inenh kaltj-anthetjam, artwang kwerrern anetj-akert church-warn kwen irrpentj-alhek. Artwang rang arnterr arlkemel ilek,
“Jesu, Nazareth-arenyay! Ngwenheh ntwang petjek? Nwernenh ywerrelh-iletjeh key? Yeng ngkweng kaltj! Ntwang Altjerr-henh urrpey mwerr anthwerr rang anem!”
Jesu-el kwerrern anetj renh arrantjakemel ilek, “Intert-irray! Artwang kwereng arratay!”
Kwerrern anetj rang artwang renh arrewetjeh mpwarek. Kwerrern anetj rang arlkerl-alhemel, artwang kwereng arraterl-alhekemeh.

Tjerrtj inang nhenh aremel anwerlkek. Inang pawenherrek, “Wenham lakenhan? Rartek nwernenh angketj lyetant twer anthwerrel kaltj-anthek! Rang kwerrern anetj map twernemeng, inang kel kwer kangkwerrem!”
Yey Jesu-akert kel Galilee ntjaper-warn antek-irrenhek.
Jesu-el Simon-kenh rtwaltj mwerr-ilek,tjerrtj mirnt-akert arrpenh map
Kel Jesu rang church-eng arratemel alhek akenheng-atherr James John atherr-akert alhek Simon Andrew atherr-henh mer-warn.
Simon-henh rtwaltj rang irlkert anthwerr intek. Inang Jesu renh ateng-ilek.
Jesu-antem marl kwer-warn alhek. Rang iltjang antwerrkemel renh kemelh-ilemel ngkernek. Marl kwereng irlkert rang ywerrek, rang mwerr-irrek. Kwer-penh rang mern ineh tjang-itek.
Kel ngway-ngway irrek. Tjerrtj mer-areny ingkerrek Simon-atherr-henh merel arraw-irrek. Inang tjerrtj irlkert map tjerrtj arrentj-akert map Jesu-warn angetjewarrekarl.
Jesu-el tjerrtj irlkert-akert map inenh mwerr-ilek. Rang arrentj map alharlkwek. Arrentj inang Jesu-eh kaltj anek. Jesu-el arrentj inenh arnpakek, inang itja kwer-penh angketjeh.
Jesu-el angketj mwerr mer Galilee ntjaperelilerl-apek
Kweny-rtweh Jesu kemerrek. Rang mereng arratemel alhek, nyent-areny anetjeh. Rang Angey-warn angketjam.
Simon tjerrtj arrpenh maparl kwer palenthwek.
Renh inang aremel ilek, “Tjerrtj ingkerrekel-artek ngkweng pawenhemel palenthwem!”

Jesu-el inenh ilek, “Mpa, nwern mer arrpenh map-warn alhetjeh. Tjeng anem, tjerrtj inenh angketj mwerr Altjerr-henh renh kaltj-antherl-apetjeh. Yeng petjek, Altjerr-kenh angketj tjerrtj ingkerrekeh kaltj-anthetjeh.”
Jesu mer map-warn alhek mer Galilee ntjaper-warn. Church nyentam-nyentel rang tjerrtj map angketj mwerr renh kaltj-anthek. Rang arrentj map alharlkwek tjerrtjeng.
Jesu-el artwang leprosy tjwen apapeth-akertmwerr-ilek

Artwang nyent leprosy-akert tjwen apapeth-akert rang Jesu-warn petjek, kwereng ularr amperel-arleng arrernelhek. Rang Jesu renh twerel pawenhek, “Yeng leprosy tjwen-akert anem. Yeng kaltj, ntwang tjerrtj mwerr-ilem. Ntwang ahentj apek anemeng, ntwang yengenh mwerr-iletjeh. Itjeng apek, itja kwetarl.”
Jesu kwer lharrp-irrek. Rang iltjel arnpemel renh ilek, “Yeng ahentj-irrem, ngwenh mwerr-iletjeh! Ntwang kel mwerram!”
Artwang kwer tjwen ywerrek. Artwang rang kel mwerr-irrek.
Jesu-el artwang renh lanthemel ilek,

“Ntwang itja tjerrtj arrpenheh nhenh-penh iletjeh. Kel ngkart priest-eh mernelhemel ilelhang. Ntwang Altjerr tjenkerr anthang, Moses-el ngkwey anthwerr tjerrtj map twernekarl-arteh. Ntwang lakenh mpwaretjeh, tjerrtj ingkerrek kaltj anetjeh, ntwang kel mwerram.”

Jesu imperl-alhemel artwang rang kel tjerrtj ingkerrek Jesu-penh ilek, nheng Jesu-el renh mwerr-ilekarl. Lakenheng Jesu ywarn anngetherr alhek town arrpenh map-warn. Rang kethelemeh anek. Tjerrtj inang ingkerrek kwer-warn petjek.
